name: 半人馬座 ω 星團
scaleRadiusMeaning: scale radius of Gaia-detected members from Vasiliev & Baumgardt2021; not a physical edge

selection.qualityFlagMeaning: five-parameter astrometric solution AND passed all author quality filters

sourceLabel: Vasiliev & Baumgardt (2021), Gaia EDR3, Zenodo version 2
licenseNote: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International; retain author credit, source and modification notice.
notes: Observed sky directions and Gaia photometry are projected to one common inferred heliocentric distance of5430±50pc. Line-of-sight depth is unknown and is not reconstructed.
Individual Gaia parallaxes are deliberately omitted from the product to prevent false depth from low-S/N inversion.
Coordinates remain at Gaia EDR3 reference epoch J2016.0. Stellar motions and internal dynamics are not propagated.
The sample is magnitude-limited G<=19 and quality-selected, and Gaia misses stars in the crowded centre. Missing stars are not replaced by random points.
Gaia observed G and BP-RP are kept; RGB colour and observing-from-another-location flux are display models.
